method: For every config_id present in both F1GRID-002 arms, compare high_low_diff_net_1x, pvalue_bootstrap_two_sided, holm_rejected and n_high/n_low/n_mid; a flip cell is one whose holm_rejected differs. Each flip cell is classified SIGN_FLIP / MATERIAL_POINT_ESTIMATE_CHANGE (|delta_net| >= threshold) / MARGINAL_POINT_ESTIMATE_CHANGE by a rule predeclared before computation.
verdict: 1 Holm-status flip cell(s) between F1GRID-002 arms A and B; classifications: H004V130=MARGINAL_POINT_ESTIMATE_CHANGE; the coverage repair changes Holm status for 1 cell(s) without a material point-estimate move (all |delta_net| < economic threshold and same sign).
conclusion: EXPLORATORY_ONLY: descriptive coverage-sensitivity diagnostic on already-inspected F1GRID-002 development data; no p-value promotion, no multiple-testing family claim, no economic inference, no sealed holdout opened, no frozen artifact modified.
